title: USC, SHS-AdC retain Cesafi swimming titles; UC makes strong haul

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of San Carlos (USC) Torpedo Warriors and Sacred Heart School-Ateneo de Cebu (SHS-AdC) Magis Eagles successfully defended their respective overall titles in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 swimming competition over the weekend at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC) pool. The Torpedo Warriors topped the collegiate division with 20 gold, 22 silver, and eight bronze medals, while the Magis Eagles dominated the high school division with 41 gold, 21 silver, and 16 bronze medals from their youth and junior swimmers.
